purpose: Outer-role replay of frozen v60/v61 gain policies on the already saved seed42 nested-controls evaluation predictions.
interpretation: Historical source data and cross-fold development results were exposed; outer-role re-evaluation only, not a new blind or globally independent confirmation.
execution_guard: run_outer_confirmation_v62.py requires --execute; this protocol-writing turn does not execute it.

roles.fit: None. No refitting, calibration, threshold search or parameter tuning.
roles.outer_evaluation: seed42 nested_controls_001 temporal_stats_predictions.csv for outer folds 0..4; labels and saved expert predictions are read only when the locked execution is explicitly run.
roles.selection: Not used in v62 execution; v60/v61 selection artifacts are frozen inputs only.

outer_input_contract.preflight_observation: Five files have 8000 rows each, 40000 rows total, and 40000 unique sample_hash values when checking only sample_hash/group columns; labels and score values are not read during protocol preflight.
outer_input_contract.expert_order: temporal then stats; first_probability is Temporal and second_probability is Stats. first_stats uses the Stats prediction as its base classifier; C/D remains referenced to first Temporal where reported.
outer_input_contract.source_features: At execution, only SOURCE x_hybrid/sample_hash/group are loaded for post-first 40-feature state; SOURCE y is never loaded.
outer_input_contract.entropy_contract: binary entropy uses log2, matching protocol/run_e0_e1_pilot.py and the frozen v60/v61 models.
outer_input_contract.provenance: raw_audit_001/selected_provenance.csv is hash-tracked for role lineage.

frozen_models.use: Load only; do not fit, calibrate, alter or select among models.

43d: the same 40 Temporal input features already paid by the first expert

frozen_models.scope: 43d is post-first-expert/offline, not early-prefix and not zero-cost.

policies.budget_rule: K=floor((budget-1)*N_outer+0.5), exact K; deterministic sample_hash tie break
policies.score_rule: For classifier, P(delta=+1)-P(delta=-1); for regression, predicted_delta; descending within exact quota. All four frozen model scores/probabilities are saved per outer row.
policies.positive_stop: For each frozen gain policy, acquire rows with score > 0 and report realized simulated calls; not a fixed quota.
policies.all_average_semantics: Repeated comparison panel at each target_budget; effective_budget remains 2.0.

metrics.reporting: Per fold, per group, and pooled 40000-row outer result; zero-denominator group recall/FPR are null; no CI and no independent-test claim.
